llm_response.reason: The website mimics the appearance and branding of the legitimate Lazada e-commerce site but is hosted on a different newly registered domain (created June 2025), with all ownership details hidden. The content attempts to entice users with claims of bonuses and exclusive products, and many interactive links direct users to another suspicious domain (waktujaya.site), showing clear signs of phishing or scam funneling. Use of references to Lazada privacy/security, live chat pressure, and urging app downloads are tactics consistent with fraudulent online shopping sites attempting to deceive users into providing personal information and/or money.
